leadersOnlyTitle.where: /manage/templates: heading of the 'not allowed' screen for non-leaders.
leadersOnlyTitle.who: signed-in members who are not band leaders

leadersOnlyDescription.who: signed-in members who are not band leaders
leadersOnlyDescription.context: Templates = the reusable running orders a new service starts from. 'Band Leaders' is a role name.

backToManage.where: /manage/templates header: accessible name of the back-arrow button to /manage.

newSlotLabel.where: Template editor: the label a newly added slot starts with (then saved as data; the leader renames it).
newSlotLabel.context: A slot = one row of a service template (a song, prayer, reading…).

savedToast.where: Template editor: confirmation toast after saving.
savedToast.context: {template} is the template's name, e.g. a service type.

saveFailed.where: Template editor: error toast when saving fails.

resetConfirm.where: Template editor: browser confirm dialog before resetting a customized template.

resetDone.where: Template editor: confirmation toast after the reset.

resetFailed.where: Template editor: error toast when the reset fails.

slotCount.where: Template editor header: number of slots in the template.
slotCount.context: {count} is a number. The English one-form reads 'slots' too: it is kept exactly as the page showed before translation.

customizedBadge.where: Template editor header: badge when the template differs from the built-in default.

defaultBadge.where: Template editor header: badge when the template is the built-in default.

resetToDefault.where: Template editor header: button that discards customizations.

addSlot.where: Template editor: button under the slot list that adds a row.

slotTypeSong.where: Template editor: slot type (small badge on each row and in the Type dropdown).
slotTypeSong.context: Lower case in English on purpose (badge style).

slotTypePrayer.where: Template editor: slot type badge / dropdown option.
slotTypePrayer.context: A label only; never put prayer text here.

slotTypeReading.where: Template editor: slot type badge / dropdown option.

slotTypeTransition.where: Template editor: slot type badge / dropdown option.

slotTypeNote.where: Template editor: slot type badge / dropdown option.

slotTypeHeader.where: Template editor: slot type badge / dropdown option (a section heading row).

linkedFallback.where: Template editor row: shown beside the link icon when a slot is linked to a chart whose name is unknown.

pageShort.where: Template editor row: page number of the linked chart in its book.

removeSlotConfirm.where: Template editor: browser confirm dialog before deleting a slot.

fieldLabel.where: Template editor, expanded slot: field label for the slot's label text.

fieldType.where: Template editor, expanded slot: field label for the slot type dropdown.

fieldLinkedChart.where: Template editor, expanded slot: field label for the chart linked to the slot.

removeLinkedChart.where: Template editor, expanded slot: accessible name of the X button that unlinks the chart.

pagePlaceholder.where: Template editor, expanded slot: placeholder of the small page-number box.

pickSong.where: Template editor, expanded slot: button that opens the library search to link a chart.

fieldQueries.where: Template editor, expanded slot: label of the search-terms box used to find a chart automatically.

fieldQueriesWithFallback.where: Same label as fieldQueries, shown when a chart is linked: the search terms are then only a fallback.

queriesPlaceholder.where: Template editor, expanded slot: example search terms in the search-terms box.
queriesPlaceholder.context: Example song-name search terms (transliterated names, not text to translate literally); keep them as names.

fieldPerformer.where: Template editor, expanded slot: label for who usually performs the slot.

performerPlaceholder.where: Template editor, expanded slot: example in the performer box.

fieldDuration.where: Template editor, expanded slot: label for the estimated length in minutes.

fieldOnlyFor.where: Template editor, expanded slot: label for the list of rabbi slot keys this slot applies to.

onlyForPlaceholder.where: Template editor, expanded slot: example in the 'Only For' box.
onlyForPlaceholder.context: {example} is a machine key such as daniel_karen (not translated).

fieldDescription.where: Template editor, expanded slot: label for the free-text description.

descriptionPlaceholder.where: Template editor, expanded slot: placeholder of the description box.
